verdict.rationale: OCI documents a concrete deprecation commitment: 12 months' advance notice before removing or changing an existing API in a way that would require code updates. The pack only describes the APIs as typical HTTPS REST APIs, with nothing on how they are versioned. missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme (version identifiers in paths or headers, version lifecycle), details of how deprecation notices are delivered, independent or hands-on corroboration of the policy in practice.
